prompt: Which documentation plan follows the woman’s advice?
promptZh: 哪一種記錄方式符合女子的建議？

options.text: Keep both pictures together but list the recipe versions separately.
options.zh: 兩張照片放一起，但兩種食譜版本在冊子裡分開列。
options.whyZh: 女子要求第一張與單拍的註記照放一起；文字的兩個版本則分開。

options.text: Use one picture and list both times on the same line.
options.zh: 只用一張照片，把兩個時間寫同一行。
options.whyZh: 應補拍註記，時間也不能寫在同一行。

options.text: Keep only the second picture and list both recipe versions separately.
options.zh: 只保留第二張照片，將兩種版本分開列。
options.whyZh: 文字做法對，但註記照片要和第一張一起保留。

options.text: Keep both pictures together and list only the shorter recipe time.
options.zh: 兩張照片放一起，冊子只列較短的時間。
options.whyZh: 應保留兩張照片，也應列兩種份量各自適用的時間。

explanationZh: 女子要求第一張與單拍的註記照放一起；文字的兩個版本則分開。
evidence: Both, but don’t put them on the same line. Twenty is for a full pan. Dad halved the recipe when he used the smaller pan. / I was planning to photograph the card first. I can see the pencil note if I lift the fold, but the clear sleeve presses it closed. / Take a second photo of the note by itself. Keep that picture with the first, but write the two versions separately in the booklet.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Both, but don’t put them on the same line. Twenty is for a full pan. Dad halved the recipe when he used the smaller pan.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I was planning to photograph the card first. I can see the pencil note if I lift the fold, but the clear sleeve presses it closed.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Take a second photo of the note by itself. Keep that picture with the first, but write the two versions separately in the booklet.
